figures.caption: Fig. 2. Basin enlargement under zero-mean pulsatile feedback. (a) Uncontrolled trajectory, starting from ρ0 = 0.8, θ0 = 0. (b) Periodic gain K(t) with a one-period detail. (c) Controlled trajectory, starting from ρ0 = 0.8, θ0 = 0. The green dash-dotted circle in (c) marks the predicted basin boundary. (d) Monte Carlo results for 10 000 initial conditions at t0 = 0, with the estimated boundary shown in purple-red. Blue and orange points indicate convergence to the origin and approach to the outer attractor, respectively. Red points (unresolved) highlight samples near the basin boundary.
